roles.title: Admission Counselor
requirements: Ability to engage with working professionals
Strong understanding of career counseling or admissions processes
responsibilities: Engage with working professionals to identify their career needs and align program benefits
Conduct online and offline product demonstrations of the MasterCamp program
Schedule and conduct consultations and follow-up sessions with prospective students
Develop an in-depth understanding of customer profiles and career aspirations
Handle objections, provide solutions, and negotiate program fees to close sales
Achieve weekly and monthly sales targets while maintaining high customer satisfaction
